name: ExchangeIssuance component inventory drain via attacker SetToken
summary: Index Coop's ExchangeIssuance accepts any SetToken registered with the Set Protocol v2 controller, sizes component purchases from the token's current position units, then calls BasicIssuanceModule.issue, which pulls the units after the set's manager-controlled pre-issue hook has run, from ExchangeIssuance's standing max approvals. The attacker created its own SetToken whose hook inflated the position multiplier, so a 0.05 WETH issueSetForExactToken pulled nearly all of ExchangeIssuance's leftover inventory of nine tokens into the set, which the attacker then redeemed.
notes: Reset: ExchangeIssuance's deployment (March 2021). The component allowances to BasicIssuanceModule date from 2021-2023, but approveSetToken() is public, so any caller could have set them for its own SetToken. The inventory had been flat since 2022 (e.g. LINK 436.70 at blocks 15000000-25644620), so no earlier drain.

Loss: ExchangeIssuance's net outflow per asset in the anchor (loss.mjs), at DefiLlama prices. Unrelated to the Set Protocol v1 RebalancingSetTokenV3 incident (0xaca5f83f): different contract, defect and year.
